_comment: Advisories that `npm run audit:check` tolerates. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry date; once expired it fails CI again and must be re-reviewed. Only list advisories with no non-breaking fix.

GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4.reason: Fixed only in glob 14.0.2+, a major bump jest 30 does not accept (the audit's suggested fix is a downgrade to jest 29). Dev-only, via jest's coverage and test discovery; it globs local paths from the repo's own config and never uses AbortSignal timeouts on untrusted input.

GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249.reason: Fixed only in minimatch 11.0.1+, a major bump jest 30 and nodemon do not accept (the audit's suggested fix is a downgrade to jest 29). Dev-only; patterns come from jest and nodemon config in this repo, never from untrusted input.
